title: European 1 km grids: EU-DEM elevation, CORINE Land Cover, Tree Cover Density, GEOSTAT population, DEGURBA, service accessibility, road transport performance
publisher: Eurostat GISCO / Copernicus Land Monitoring Service / JRC (tiled by J. Gaffuri, github.com/jgaffuri/tiledgrids)
license: Eurostat/GISCO reuse policy (free reuse with attribution: © EuroGeographics for administrative boundaries; Copernicus data: free, full and open, attribution required)
description: 1 km cells in ETRS89-LAEA (EPSG:3035). Elevation = EU-DEM v1.1; land cover = CORINE Land Cover (1990–2018, class of the 1 km cell); tree cover density = Copernicus HRL TCD (2012–2018); population = GEOSTAT grids 2006/2011/2018 (+2021); DEGURBA grid classes; average time to the nearest primary school and hospital; population reachable by road in 90 min.

title: Natural Earth 1:10m cultural and physical vectors
description: Lakes (incl. the European supplement), rivers (incl. the European supplement), glaciated areas, roads with ferry routes, railroads, ports, populated places, 200 m bathymetry, sea names.

title: Municipal and regional boundaries (Norway 2024, Sweden, Denmark) and NUTS 2024
publisher: Kartverket (NO, via github.com/robhop/fylker-og-kommuner); Valmyndigheten (SE, via github.com/okfse/sweden-geojson); Geodatastyrelsen DAGI (DK, via github.com/Neogeografen/dagi); Eurostat GISCO NUTS 2024 (via github.com/eurostat/Nuts2json)
license: NO: CC BY 4.0 Kartverket; SE: public data, reuse permitted; DK: free data (Geodatastyrelsen terms); NUTS: © EuroGeographics for the administrative boundaries
description: Simplified polygons. Used only to assign 1 km grid cells and hexes to municipalities and NUTS 3 regions; statistics always come from the statistical agencies at municipal level.

title: Euronym place-name labels
publisher: Eurostat GISCO (from EuroGeographics EuroRegionalMap and the EC towns table)
description: Settlement names with the map resolution above which each label is hidden (rs): the published zoom level for displaying town names.

title: OurAirports airport database
description: Airport locations, ICAO codes and size class; matched to Eurostat passenger counts by ICAO code.

title: powerplantmatching: matched European power plant database
publisher: PyPSA / powerplantmatching (Gotzens, Hofmann et al.), combining ENTSO-E, OPSD, JRC, GEO, GPD
license: Data: CC BY 4.0 (aggregated from open sources; see project for per-source terms)
description: Power plants with fuel type, technology, installed capacity (MW) and coordinates.
used_for: energy resources on the map (installed capacity, not generation)

title: Statistics Norway (SSB) StatBank: population, area, employment by place of work, household income
description: Tables 07459 (population 1 January by age, municipalities 2024 boundaries with aggregated time series), 09280 (land and freshwater area), 07984 (employed persons 4th quarter by place of work and industry, SIC2007 17 groups), 06944 (median household income after tax), 08585 (students by institution).

title: Statistics Sweden (SCB) Statistical Database: population, land area, employment by place of work, income
description: TAB628 (population, land area and density by municipality, 31 December), TAB5557/TAB638 (population by age), TAB3204 (employed 15–74 by region of work and NACE Rev. 2, annual register BAS), TAB4840 (median net income, persons 20+). From reference year 2025 SCB adds small random noise to protect privacy (cell key method), so parts may not sum exactly to totals.

title: Statistics Denmark (DST) StatBank: population, area, employment by workplace, income
license: CC BY 4.0 (Statistics Denmark terms of use)
description: FOLK1A (population 1st day of Q1, by municipality and age), ARE207 (area 1 January), RAS501 (employed end November by workplace municipality and industry, DB25 36-grouping; also gives the landsdel (NUTS 3) of each municipality), INDKP107 (average disposable income per person).

title: Eurostat: regional GDP (NUTS 3), electricity production, airport passengers, port freight
description: nama_10r_3gdp (GDP at current market prices by NUTS 3 region: million EUR and PPS per inhabitant), nama_10r_3popgdp (average population used for GDP per capita), nrg_bal_peh (gross electricity production by fuel), avia_paoa (passengers carried by reporting airport), mar_mg_aa_pwhd (gross weight of goods handled in main ports).

title: Regional GDP from the national accounts of Norway, Sweden and Denmark, with Eurostat exchange rates and PPPs
publisher: SSB (tables 09391, 11713), SCB (TAB3138), DST (NRHP, INDKP101), Eurostat (ert_bil_eur_a, prc_ppp_ind, nama_10r_3gva)
license: NLOD/CC BY 4.0 (SSB), CC0 (SCB), CC BY 4.0 (DST, Eurostat)
description: Gross domestic product at current prices by county (fylke), län and landsdel for 2023, converted to euro with Eurostat annual average exchange rates and to PPS with Eurostat GDP purchasing power parities (EU27_2020 = 1). Norway's continental shelf (oil and gas extraction, pipeline transport) is 'extra-regio' and belongs to no county.

title: Wikidata: World Heritage Sites, universities and national parks in Norway, Sweden and Denmark
description: SPARQL queries (in pipeline/sources/extra.py) for items with a UNESCO World Heritage Site ID (P757), universities (university / public university / technical university / research university, not dissolved) and national parks (Q46169), with coordinates, student numbers, area and dates. Used only for the location and identity of documented landmarks; the inclusion rule for each wonder class is published in wonders.json.

title: Norwegian Offshore Directorate FactPages and FactMaps: oil and gas fields and production
license: NLOD 2.0 (Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data)
description: Field outlines (FactMaps layer 502 'Field by status') and yearly saleable production per field (million Sm³ oil equivalents).

title: SGU Mineral resources database (mines, quarries and deposits)
publisher: Sveriges geologiska undersökning (Geological Survey of Sweden)
description: Ore and mineral occurrences with economic status. Only entries classed 'mine/quarry' and 'deposit' are used; production status comes from the production start/end fields.

title: Fixed links (Wikidata) and main-port freight (Eurostat)
description: Bridges and tunnels in Norway, Sweden and Denmark recorded with a length of at least 5 km; gross weight of goods handled in main ports (Eurostat mar_go_aa).

title: Tilfluktsrom – Offentlige (public shelters)
publisher: Direktoratet for samfunnssikkerhet og beredskap (DSB); WFS hosted by Kartverket (Geonorge)
license: NLOD 1.0 (Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data)
description: Public civil-defence shelters in Norway: position (ETRS89), shelter room number, registered places (plasser) and the published address/description. Public shelters only: private shelters, which make up most of Norway's shelter places, are not in this dataset.

title: Public camera uplinks (links to providers' public webcam pages)
publisher: CamStreamer (public camera map), Panomax (public camera search), SkylineWebcams and operators' own pages (links only), Wikidata (place coordinates, CC0); selection by NordicCiv
license: Facts and links only: names, positions and page addresses as each provider publishes them, with attribution; Wikidata CC0. No camera images or streams are copied.
description: Webcams their operators publish for anyone to watch, in Norway, Sweden and Denmark, kept as a name, a position, a category, a provider and the provider's public viewing page. NordicCiv links to the provider's public viewing page.

title: WMO station climate normals, 1991–2020
publisher: MET Norway, SMHI and DMI; WMO / NOAA NCEI archive
description: Selected station monthly and annual temperature and precipitation normals, 1991–2020. National meteorological agency submissions in NCEI archive version 6.6; not municipal averages.

title: NVE flood zones
publisher: Norwegian Water Resources and Energy Directorate (NVE)
license: NLOD 1.0 (Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data)
description: Published current and updated flood polygons for the 200-year modelled event.

title: Norwegian municipality commuting, 2024
description: Employed people aged 15–74 by municipality of residence and workplace, fourth quarter 2024. Only domestic intermunicipal pairs with at least 25 published employed people are shown. Not counts of trips, routes or travel modes.
used_for: Municipality commuting partners and schematic map connections

title: Swedish municipality commuting, 2024
description: Annual register, employed people aged 15–74 by municipality of residence and workplace. Published totals for both sexes; statistical disclosure protection applies.

title: Danish municipality commuting, 2024
description: Employed people at end November by municipality of residence and workplace. Both sex counts must be published and nonzero; zero is also the suppression value, so pairs with a zero are omitted.

title: Danish aviation and selected ferry connections, 2024
description: FLYV33, FLYV34, SKIB31 and SKIB32. Passenger movements and freight tonnes remain separate. Rounded thousands converted to movements or tonnes; zero or suppressed cells are omitted.
